research.title: From Scanner Findings to Verifiable Web Application Risk
research.summary: Web application scanners can surface potential vulnerabilities. They don’t always prove what attackers can actually exploit or give developers the evidence they need to act. A cloud-native merchandise returns technology provider needed a better way to.
